pages.title: Auto-Submit Storage
pages.text: The Protocol Stash is a special storage block. When powered, it auto-submits contents to $(l:arknights_endfield:logistics/global_storage)Global Storage$() every 10s.$(br2)When unpowered, it's a regular 27-slot chest.

pages.title: Use Cases
pages.text: Protocol Stashes excel as production line buffers:$(br)1. Input machine output via belts into the stash$(br)2. When powered, items auto-submit to Global Storage$(br)3. Use Unloaders elsewhere to retrieve and continue processing$(br2)Enables seamless cross-region item flow.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
